description: Asks Google how it sees one URL: whether it is indexed and why not, the canonical Google chose against the declared one, when it was last crawled and as which device, robots.txt and noindex state, the sitemaps and pages that point to it, and structured data problems. It reports the indexed version, not a live test. Counts against a quota of 2,000 inspections per day per property.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language for Google's issue messages, for example "en-US" (default) or "el".

site_url.description: Search Console property, for example "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://www.example.com/". A bare domain or any page URL on the site also works. Optional when GSC_SITE_URL is set or the account has exactly one property.

url.description: The full URL to inspect. It must belong to the property.

name: inspect_url
title: Inspect a URL
